host.title: Host app
host.nav.label: Host sections
host.home.heading: Your offer, in your own words
host.home.lead: Say what you offer and the assistant turns it into a listing draft. It writes only the title and the description. The price, the season, the capacity and the accessibility are entered and confirmed by you.
host.home.step1: Record your description, or type it. Recording works without a connection: the recording is stored on this device and uploads by itself when connectivity returns.
host.home.step2: Read the transcript and correct anything that was heard wrongly.
host.home.step3: The assistant drafts a title and a description in Montenegrin and English — nothing else.
host.home.step4: You enter the price, the season, the capacity, the accessibility and the location, and you confirm each one.
host.home.step5: You give your consent and the listing goes to the validators at Expeditio. Nothing is published before it has been approved.
host.home.rulesHeading: What this app does, and what it does not do
host.home.drafts: It drafts the title and the description only. The price, the season, the capacity and the accessibility are entered and confirmed by you — they are never guessed and never filled in for you.
host.home.timer: The wizard measures active authoring time — the minutes you are actually working. Waiting for the validator does not count. The target is 30 minutes of active time.
host.home.offline: A recording is stored on this device and uploads by itself when connectivity returns. The queue survives closing the page.
host.home.consent: Your description is published on the prototype site in Montenegrin and English, after Expeditio has checked it. You may withdraw your consent at any time. There are no payments.
host.home.prototype: This is a prototype with sample data, built for the SMART ERA application. It is not a commercial service.
host.wizard.heading: New listing
host.wizard.intro: Seven steps. You can stop at any point and come back: your answers and your recordings stay on this device.
host.wizard.resumed: Continued where you stopped — your draft was restored from this device.
host.timer.note: Waiting for the validator is not counted.
host.timer.state.paused_hidden: paused — this tab is in the background
host.start.languageHint: Speak in the language you are most comfortable in. The listing is published in both languages either way.
host.start.villageHint: A listing belongs to one village; the validator sees it together with its municipality.
host.start.villagesUnavailable: The list of villages could not be loaded. Try again when you are online.
host.start.onBehalfHint: Ambassadors may fill a listing in together with a host. Leave it empty to record your own.
host.start.created: The session has started; your active time is being counted.
host.record.intro: Say what you offer, the way you would tell a guest.
host.record.prompt: For example: what it is, where it is, what a visitor gets, when you are open, and anything a guest should know beforehand.
host.record.unsupported: This browser cannot record audio. Upload an audio file or type your description instead.
host.record.denied: The microphone was not allowed. Upload an audio file or type your description instead.
host.record.typeHint: Write it as you would say it; the assistant uses these words the same way.
host.record.savedOffline: Saved on this device ({count} waiting). It uploads by itself when connectivity returns.
host.record.queuedForTranscription: The recording arrived; the transcript is being prepared.
host.record.pollTimeout: The transcript is not ready yet. Come back later, or type the text yourself.
host.transcript.intro: This is what was heard. Correct anything that is wrong — the assistant works from these words only.
host.transcript.label: Transcript
host.transcript.generate: Draft the title and the description
host.draft.intro: The assistant drafted a title and a description in both languages. Edit them freely — they are your words.
host.draft.hint: These are the only fields the assistant drafts. Everything else you enter yourself on the next step.
host.draft.translationPending: The second language has not been translated yet; a validator completes it before publication.
host.details.intro: The price, the season, the capacity and the accessibility are entered and confirmed by you. The assistant never fills them in and never guesses them.
host.details.neverInferred: Nothing on this step is taken from your recording. You type each fact yourself and tick the box to confirm it.
host.details.stillEmpty: Still empty: {fields}. You may confirm them empty, but the validator will see them as missing.
host.confirm.all: I confirm that all the details below are mine and correct
host.confirm.blocked: Confirm every group of details before you send the listing.
host.group.priceHint: A range is fine. Leave it empty and write a note if the price depends on the arrangement.
host.group.noPayments: No payment is ever taken in this prototype; the price is information for the visitor.
host.field.capacityHint: How many people you can take at one time.
host.field.coordsHint: Approximate coordinates are fine — the visitor app says so on the map.
host.field.titleRequired: Enter a title in at least one language.
host.field.descriptionRequired: Enter a description in at least one language.
host.field.villageRequired: Choose the village the listing belongs to.
host.field.priceOrder: The price from cannot be higher than the price to.
host.field.seasonPair: Enter both months of the season, or tick “open all year”.
host.field.coordsPair: Enter both the latitude and the longitude, or leave both empty.
host.geo.error: Your location could not be read. Type the coordinates instead.
host.geo.unsupported: This browser cannot give a location.
host.village.unverifiedNote: The facts about this village are not verified yet: {note}
host.village.unverifiedShort: This village is marked as not verified; a validator checks it before publication.
host.consent.intro: Read the consent text. It is version v1 and it is shown in both languages, whichever language you are using here.
host.consent.checkbox: I have read the text and I give my consent (v1)
host.consent.withdraw: You may withdraw your consent at any time; the listing is then removed from publication.
host.consent.required: Tick the consent box before you send the listing.
host.consent.submit: Give consent and send to validation
host.done.status: The listing was sent to validation.
host.done.queued: Your listing is in the validation queue.
host.done.elapsedNote: waiting included; this is not compared against the target
host.done.missingResult: The result of this session is no longer in this browser. Open “My listings” to see the listing.
host.queue.heading: Recordings on this device
host.queue.explain: A recording is stored on this device first and uploads by itself when connectivity returns. The queue survives closing the page.
host.queue.emptyOffline: nothing is waiting; new recordings are kept here until you are online
host.queue.pendingOffline: {count} saved on this device, waiting for a connection
host.queue.unsupported: This browser cannot store recordings on the device. Record only while you are online.
host.queue.state.failed: upload failed — it will be retried
host.queue.deleteConfirm: Delete this recording from the device?
host.listings.heading: My listings
host.listings.intro: Every listing you have made, in every status. Visitors only ever see the approved ones.
host.listings.empty: You have no listings yet. Start with “New listing”.
host.listing.editWarning: Saving creates a new version and sends the listing back to draft, so a validator checks it again before it is published.
host.listing.saved: Saved as version {version}; it is waiting for validation.
host.listing.missing: The validator will see these as missing: {fields}
host.gender.heading: About my data (voluntary)
host.gender.why: The project reports how many women and men take part. Answering is voluntary and it changes nothing about your listing.
host.gender.point1: The answer is used only for aggregate statistics; it is never shown next to your listing.
host.gender.point2: You may leave it unanswered — that is a normal outcome, and nothing in this app depends on it.
host.gender.point3: You can give or change your answer at any time.
host.gender.optional: Answering is voluntary; leaving this unanswered is perfectly fine.
host.gender.saved: Your answer was saved. Thank you.
host.gender.notAnswered: You have not answered — that is fine.
host.requests.heading: Visitor requests
host.requests.intro: Messages visitors have sent about your listings. Answer in a few words; the visitor sees your reply.
host.requests.noBookings: A request is a message, not a booking. There are no reservations and no payments in this prototype.
host.request.replyHint: Write a short answer. It is sent together with your decision, so a refusal is never silent.
host.request.replyRequired: Write a reply before you confirm or refuse.
host.request.confirmed: Confirmed; the visitor can see your reply.
host.request.refused: Refused; the visitor can see your reply.
host.request.noteHint: For your own record and for the statistics; the visitor does not see it.
